      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "def _render_model_selector_compact() -\u003e None:\n    \"\"\"渲染紧凑版模型选择器\"\"\"\n    try:\n        models = get_available_models()\n        if not models:\n            st.caption(\"⚠️ 无模型\")\n            return\n        \n        # 构建选项字典\n        model_options = {model.name: model.id for model in models}\n        model_names = list(model_options.keys())\n        \n        # 获取当前选择的模型\n        current_model_id = st.session_state.get('selected_model', config.get_default_llm_id())\n        \n        # 找到当前模型索引\n        current_index = 0\n        for i, (name, model_id) in enumerate(model_options.items()):\n            if model_id == current_model_id:\n                current_index = i\n                break\n        \n        # 紧凑版选择器（无标签）\n        # 注意：状态更新在 on_change 回调中处理，避免冗余\n        st.selectbox(\n            \"模型\",\n            options=model_names,\n            index=current_index,\n            key=\"model_selector_compact\",\n            label_visibility=\"collapsed\",\n            on_change=_on_model_change,\n        )\n    \n    except Exception as e:\n        st.caption(f\"⚠️ {e}\")\n\n\ndef _render_agentic_rag_toggle() -\u003e None:\n    \"\"\"渲染 Agentic RAG 模式切换按钮\"\"\"",

        "contents": "def render_llm_preset_selector(\n    on_preset_change: Optional[Callable[[str], None]] = None,\n) -\u003e None:\n    \"\"\"渲染 LLM 预设选择器\n    \n    Args:\n        on_preset_change: 预设变更回调\n    \"\"\"\n    # 初始化状态\n    if 'llm_preset' not in st.session_state:\n        st.session_state.llm_preset = 'balanced'\n    \n    current_preset = st.session_state.llm_preset\n    \n    # 检查当前模型是否为推理模型（不支持 temperature）\n    current_model_id = st.session_state.get(\n        'selected_model', config.get_default_llm_id()\n    )\n    model_config = config.get_llm_model_config(current_model_id)\n    is_reasoning_model = model_config and model_config.supports_reasoning\n    \n    # 构建选项\n    preset_keys = list(LLM_PRESETS.keys())\n    preset_names = [LLM_PRESETS[k][\"name\"] for k in preset_keys]\n    \n    current_index = preset_keys.index(current_preset) if current_preset in preset_keys else 1\n    \n    # 预设选择\n    st.markdown(\"**🎨 回答风格**\")\n    \n    if is_reasoning_model:\n        st.caption(\"⚠️ 推理模型不支持调整风格\")\n        # 显示但禁用\n        st.radio(\n            \"选择风格\",\n            options=preset_names,\n            index=current_index,\n            key=\"llm_preset_radio_disabled\",\n            disabled=True,\n            label_visibility=\"collapsed\",\n        )\n    else:\n        selected_name = st.radio(\n            \"选择风格\",\n            options=preset_names,\n            index=current_index,\n            key=\"llm_preset_radio\",\n            label_visibility=\"collapsed\",\n        )\n        \n        # 更新预设\n        selected_key = preset_keys[preset_names.index(selected_name)]\n        if selected_key != current_preset:\n            st.session_state.llm_preset = selected_key\n            if on_preset_change:\n                on_preset_change(selected_key)\n    \n    # 显示当前预设说明\n    preset_info = LLM_PRESETS.get(current_preset, LLM_PRESETS[\"balanced\"])\n    st.caption(f\"💡 {preset_info['description']}\")\n    \n    if not is_reasoning_model:\n        st.caption",

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "\"\"\"\n主配置面板 - 集成各子组件，提供统一的配置入口\n\n主要功能：\n- render_sidebar_config(): 侧边栏常用配置（模型、预设、检索策略）\n- render_advanced_config(): 设置弹窗高级配置（RAG 参数、显示设置）\n\"\"\"\n\nimport streamlit as st\nfrom typing import Callable, Optional\n\nfrom backend.infrastructure.config import config\nfrom frontend.components.config_panel.llm_presets import (\n    render_model_selector,\n    render_llm_preset_selector,\n)\nfrom frontend.components.config_panel.rag_params import (\n    render_rag_basic_params,\n    render_rag_advanced_params,\n)\n\n\ndef render_sidebar_config(\n    on_config_change: Optional[Callable[[], None]] = None,\n) -\u003e None:\n    \"\"\"渲染侧边栏常用配置\n    \n    包含：\n    - 模型选择\n    - LLM 预设（精确/平衡/创意）\n    - 检索策略\n    - Agentic RAG 开关\n    \n    Args:\n        on_config_change: 配置变更回调（用于触发服务重建）\n    \"\"\"\n    # 模型选择\n    render_model_selector(on_model_change=lambda _: _trigger_rebuild(on_config_change))\n    \n    st.divider()\n    \n    # LLM 预设\n    render_llm_preset_selector(on_preset_change=lambda _: _trigger_rebuild(on_config_change))\n    \n    st.divider()\n    \n    # RAG 基础参数\n    render_rag_basic_params(\n        on_strategy_change=lambda _: _trigger_rebuild(on_config_change),\n        on_agentic_toggle=lambda _: _trigger_rebuild(on_config_change),\n    )\n\n\ndef _trigger_rebuild(callback: Optional[Callable[[], None]]) -\u003e None:\n    \"\"\"触发服务重建\"\"\"\n    if callback:\n        callback()",
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "lineNumber": 1,
            "text": "\"\"\""
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2,
            "text": "主配置面板 - 集成各子组件，提供统一的配置入口"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 3

          {
            "lineNumber": 4,
            "text": "主要功能："

            "lineNumber": 5,
            "text": "- render_sidebar_config(): 侧边栏常用配置（模型、预设、检索策略）"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6,
            "text": "- render_advanced_config(): 设置弹窗高级配置（RAG 参数、显示设置）"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 7,
            "text": "\"\"\""
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 10,

          {
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12,
            "text": "from backend.infrastructure.config import config"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 13,
            "text": "from frontend.components.config_panel.llm_presets import ("
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 14,
            "text": "    render_model_selector,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 15,
            "text": "    render_llm_preset_selector,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 16,
            "text": ")"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 17,
            "text": "from frontend.components.config_panel.rag_params import ("
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 18,
            "text": "    render_rag_basic_params,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 19,
            "text": "    render_rag_advanced_params,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20,
            "text": ")"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "isSignature": true,
            "lineNumber": 23,
            "text": "def render_sidebar_config("
          },
          {
            "isSignature": true,
            "lineNumber": 24,
            "text": "    on_config_change: Optional[Callable[[], None]] = None,"
          },
          {
            "isSignature": true,
            "lineNumber": 25,
            "text": ") -\u003e None:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 26,
            "text": "    \"\"\"渲染侧边栏常用配置"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27,
            "text": "    "
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 28,
            "text": "    包含："
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 29,
            "text": "    - 模型选择"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 30,
            "text": "    - LLM 预设（精确/平衡/创意）"

          {

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 34,
            "text": "    Args:"

        "contents": "def render_chat_input_with_mode(\n    placeholder: str = \"给系统发送消息\",\n    key: str = \"chat_input\",\n    disabled: bool = False\n) -\u003e Optional[str]:\n    \"\"\"渲染整合的聊天输入区域（参考 DeepSeek 设计）\n    \n    布局：\n    - 上方：输入框\n    - 下方：[模型选择 ▼] [🤖 Agentic] [⚙️] ─── [发送]\n    \n    Args:\n        placeholder: 输入框占位符文本\n        key: Streamlit组件key\n        disabled: 是否禁用输入框（思考中时隐藏）\n        \n    Returns:\n        用户输入的文本，如果未输入或未点击发送则返回None\n    \"\"\"\n    from frontend.components.params_dialog import show_params_dialog\n    \n    # 初始化状态\n    if 'use_agentic_rag' not in st.session_state:\n        st.session_state.use_agentic_rag = False\n    if f'{key}_input_value' not in st.session_state:\n        st.session_state[f'{key}_input_value'] = ''\n    if 'selected_model' not in st.session_state:\n        st.session_state.selected_model = config.get_default_llm_id()\n    \n    # 检查是否发送（在渲染之前检查）\n    user_input = None\n    if st.session_state.get(f'{key}_send_clicked', False):\n        user_input = st.session_state.get(f'{key}_input_value', '').strip()\n        if user_input:\n            st.session_state[f'{key}_input_value'] = ''\n        st.session_state[f'{key}_send_clicked'] = False\n    \n    # 渲染输入区域\n    with st.container():",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "def _render_input_actions(input_key: str, input_value: str) -\u003e None:\n    \"\"\"渲染输入区域下方的操作按钮\n    \n    布局：[模型选择 ▼] [🤖 Agentic] [⚙️] ─── [发送]\n    \"\"\"\n    col_model, col_agentic, col_params, col_spacer, col_send = st.columns([2, 1.5, 0.5, 2, 1])\n    \n    with col_model:\n        _render_model_selector_compact()\n    \n    with col_agentic:\n        _render_agentic_rag_toggle()\n    \n    with col_params:\n        st.button(\n            \"⚙️\",\n            key=\"params_button\",\n            help=\"参数配置\",\n            on_click=_on_params_click,\n        )\n    \n    # col_spacer 为空，用于占位\n    \n    with col_send:\n        st.button(\n            \"发送\",\n            key=f\"{input_key}_send_button\",\n            type=\"primary\",\n            use_container_width=True,\n            disabled=not input_value,\n            on_click=_on_send_click,\n            args=(input_key,)\n        )\n\n\ndef _render_model_selector_compact() -\u003e None:\n    \"\"\"渲染紧凑版模型选择器\"\"\"",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "\"\"\"\n参数配置弹窗组件\n在输入框下方的 ⚙️ 按钮点击后弹出\n\n主要功能：\n- show_params_dialog(): 显示参数配置弹窗（LLM 预设、检索参数、显示设置）\n\"\"\"\n\nimport streamlit as st\nfrom frontend.utils.state import rebuild_services\nfrom frontend.components.config_panel.llm_presets import render_llm_preset_selector\nfrom frontend.components.config_panel.rag_params import (\n    render_rag_basic_params,\n    render_rag_advanced_params,\n)\nfrom frontend.components.config_panel.panel import _render_display_settings\n\n\n@st.dialog(\"参数配置\", width=\"large\", icon=\"⚙️\")\ndef show_params_dialog() -\u003e None:\n    \"\"\"显示参数配置弹窗\"\"\"\n    # Tab 切换\n    tab_basic, tab_advanced = st.tabs([\"🎨 基础\", \"🔧 高级\"])\n    \n    with tab_basic:\n        # LLM 预设（回答风格）\n        render_llm_preset_selector(on_preset_change=lambda _: rebuild_services())\n        \n        st.markdown(\"---\")\n        \n        # 检索策略\n        render_rag_basic_params(\n            on_strategy_change=lambda _: rebuild_services(),\n            on_agentic_toggle=lambda _: rebuild_services(),\n        )\n    \n    with tab_advanced:\n        # RAG 高级参数\n        render_rag_advanced_params(on_params_change=rebuild_services)\n        \n        st.markdown(\"---\")\n        \n        # 显示设置\n        _render_display_settings(on_config_change=rebuild_services)",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "\"\"\"\n配置数据模型 - AppConfig 和 LLM 预设定义\n\n主要功能：\n- AppConfig: 应用运行时配置，作为 session_state 的读写桥梁\n- LLM_PRESETS: LLM 预设配置（精确/平衡/创意）\n- get_preset_params(): 获取预设参数\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom typing import Dict, Any, Optional\n\nimport streamlit as st\n\nfrom backend.infrastructure.config import config\n\n\n# LLM 预设定义\nLLM_PRESETS: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {\n    \"precise\": {\n        \"name\": \"🎯 精确模式\",\n        \"description\": \"适合代码、技术问答、数据分析\",\n        \"temperature\": 0.3,\n        \"max_tokens\": 4096,\n    },\n    \"balanced\": {\n        \"name\": \"⚖️ 平衡模式\",\n        \"description\": \"默认模式，适合大多数场景\",\n        \"temperature\": 0.7,\n        \"max_tokens\": 4096,\n    },\n    \"creative\": {\n        \"name\": \"💡 创意模式\",\n        \"description\": \"适合头脑风暴、创意写作\",\n        \"temperature\": 1.3,\n        \"max_tokens\": 8192,\n    },\n}\n\n\ndef get_preset_params(preset_key: str) -\u003e Dict[str, Any]:\n    \"\"\"获取预设参数\n    \n    Args:\n        preset_key: 预设键名（precise/balanced/creative）\n        \n    Returns:\n        预设参数字典，包含 temperature 和 max_tokens\n    \"\"\"\n    preset = LLM_PRESETS.get(preset_key, LLM_PRESETS[\"balanced\"])\n    return {\n        \"temperature\": preset[\"temperature\"],\n        \"max_tokens\": preset[\"max_tokens\"],\n    }\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass AppConfig:\n    \"\"\"应用运行时配置\n    \n    作为 session_state 的读写桥梁，不在 session_state 中存储实例本身。\n    ",
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "lineNumber": 1,
            "text": "\"\"\""

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "\"\"\"\nRAG 参数面板组件 - RAG 检索参数的 UI 控制\n\n主要功能：\n- render_rag_basic_params(): 基础参数（检索策略、Agentic 开关）\n- render_rag_advanced_params(): 高级参数（top_k、threshold、rerank）\n\"\"\"\n\nimport streamlit as st\nfrom typing import Callable, Optional\n\nfrom backend.infrastructure.config import config\n\n\n# 检索策略选项\nRETRIEVAL_STRATEGIES = {\n    \"vector\": \"向量检索\",\n    \"bm25\": \"BM25 关键词检索\",\n    \"hybrid\": \"混合检索\",\n    \"multi\": \"多策略融合\",\n}\n\n\ndef render_rag_basic_params(\n    on_strategy_change: Optional[Callable[[str], None]] = None,\n    on_agentic_toggle: Optional[Callable[[bool], None]] = None,\n) -\u003e None:\n    \"\"\"渲染 RAG 基础参数面板\n    \n    Args:\n        on_strategy_change: 检索策略变更回调\n        on_agentic_toggle: Agentic RAG 切换回调\n    \"\"\"\n    # 初始化状态\n    if 'retrieval_strategy' not in st.session_state:\n        st.session_state.retrieval_strategy = config.RETRIEVAL_STRATEGY\n    if 'use_agentic_rag' not in st.session_state:\n        st.session_state.use_agentic_rag = False\n    \n    # 检索策略选择\n    strategy_names = list(RETRIEVAL_STRATEGIES.values())\n    strategy_keys = list(RETRIEVAL_STRATEGIES.keys())\n    \n    current_strategy = st.session_state.retrieval_strategy\n    current_index = strategy_keys.index(current_strategy) if current_strategy in strategy_keys else 0\n    \n    # Agentic RAG 启用时禁用策略选择\n    is_agentic = st.session_state.use_agentic_rag\n    \n    selected_name = st.selectbox(\n        \"🔍 检索策略\",\n        options=strategy_names,\n        index=current_index,\n        key=\"retrieval_strategy_selector\",\n        disabled=is_agentic,\n        help=\"选择文档检索方式。启用 Agentic RAG 时由 AI 自动选择。\"\n    )\n    \n    # 更新策略\n    selected_key = strategy_keys[strategy_names.index(selected_name)]\n    if selected_key != current_strategy and not is_agentic:\n        st.session_state.retrieval_strategy = selected_key",
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "lineNumber": 1,
            "text": "\"\"\""
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2,
            "text": "RAG 参数面板组件 - RAG 检索参数的 UI 控制"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4,
            "text": "主要功能："
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 5,
            "text": "- render_rag_basic_params(): 基础参数（检索策略、Agentic 开关）"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6,
            "text": "- render_rag_advanced_params(): 高级参数（top_k、threshold、rerank）"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 7,
            "text": "\"\"\""
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 9,
            "text": "import streamlit as st"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10,
            "text": "from typing import Callable, Optional"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12,
            "text": "from backend.infrastructure.config import config"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 15,
            "text": "# 检索策略选项"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 16,
            "text": "RETRIEVAL_STRATEGIES = {"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 17,
            "text": "    \"vector\": \"向量检索\","
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 18,
            "text": "    \"bm25\": \"BM25 关键词检索\","
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 19,
            "text": "    \"hybrid\": \"混合检索\","
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20,
            "text": "    \"multi\": \"多策略融合\","
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 21,
            "text": "}"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "isSignature": true,
            "lineNumber": 24,
            "text": "def render_rag_basic_params("
          },
          {
            "isSignature": true,
            "lineNumber": 25,
            "text": "    on_strategy_change: Optional[Callable[[str], None]] = None,"
          },
          {
            "isSignature": true,
            "lineNumber": 26,
            "text": "    on_agentic_toggle: Optional[Callable[[bool], None]] = None,"
          },
          {
            "isSignature": true,
            "lineNumber": 27,
            "text": ") -\u003e None:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 28,
            "text": "    \"\"\"渲染 RAG 基础参数面板"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 29,
            "text": "    "
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 30,
            "text": "    Args:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 31,
            "text": "        on_strategy_change: 检索策略变更回调"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 32,
            "text": "        on_agentic_toggle: Agentic RAG 切换回调"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 33,
            "text": "    \"\"\""
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 34,
            "text": "    # 初始化状态"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 35,
            "text": "    if 'retrieval_strategy' not in st.session_state:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 36,
            "text": "        st.session_state.retrieval_strategy = config.RETRIEVAL_STRATEGY"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 37,
            "text": "    if 'use_agentic_rag' not in st.session_state:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 38,
            "text": "        st.session_state.use_agentic_rag = False"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 39,
            "text": "    "
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 40,
            "text": "    # 检索策略选择"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 41,
            "text": "    strategy_names = list(RETRIEVAL_STRATEGIES.values())"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 42,
            "text": "    strategy_keys = list(RETRIEVAL_STRATEGIES.keys())"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 43,
            "text": "    "
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 44,
            "text": "    current_strategy = st.session_state.retrieval_strategy"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 45,
            "text": "    current_index = strategy_keys.index(current_strategy) if current_strategy in strategy_keys else 0"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 46,
            "text": "    "
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 47,
            "text": "    # Agentic RAG 启用时禁用策略选择"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 48,
            "text": "    is_agentic = st.session_state.use_agentic_rag"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 49,
            "text": "    "
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 50,
            "text": "    selected_name = st.selectbox("
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 51,
            "text": "        \"🔍 检索策略\","
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 52,
            "text": "        options=strategy_names,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 53,
            "text": "        index=current_index,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 54,
            "text": "        key=\"retrieval_strategy_selector\","
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 55,
            "text": "        disabled=is_agentic,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 56,
            "text": "        help=\"选择文档检索方式。启用 Agentic RAG 时由 AI 自动选择。\""
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 57,
            "text": "    )"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 58,
            "text": "    "
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 59,
            "text": "    # 更新策略"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 60,
            "text": "    selected_key = strategy_keys[strategy_names.index(selected_name)]"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 61,
            "text": "    if selected_key != current_strategy and not is_agentic:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 62,
            "text": "        st.session_state.retrieval_strategy = selected_key"
          }
        ],

        "contents": "def init_session_state() -\u003e None:\nlist_repositories()\n    \n    # 调试模式与可观测性（默认开启）\n    if 'debug_mode_enabled' not in st.session_state:\n        st.session_state.debug_mode_enabled = True\n    \n    # 追踪信息默认启用，无需配置\n    if 'collect_trace' not in st.session_state:\n        st.session_state.collect_trace = True\n    \n    # RAG服务（新架构）\n    if 'rag_service' not in st.session_state:\n        st.session_state.rag_service = None\n    \n    # 启动遮罩：首屏加载完成前为 False，完成后置 True\n    if 'boot_ready' not in st.session_state:\n        st.session_state.boot_ready = False\n    \n    # 对话设置（推理链）\n    if 'show_reasoning' not in st.session_state:\n        st.session_state.show_reasoning = config.DEEPSEEK_ENABLE_REASONING_DISPLAY\n    \n    if 'store_reasoning' not in st.session_state:\n        st.session_state.store_reasoning = config.DEEPSEEK_STORE_REASONING\n    \n    # Agentic RAG 设置（默认禁用）\n    if 'use_agentic_rag' not in st.session_state:\n        st.session_state.use_agentic_rag = False\n    \n    # 服务验证状态缓存（避免每次rerun都验证）\n    if 'rag_service_validated' not in st.session_state:\n        st.session_state.rag_service_validated = False\n    \n    if 'index_manager_validated' not in st.session_state:\n        st.session_state.index_manager_validated = False\n    \n    # 强制验证标志（当配置变更时需要重新验证）\n    if 'force_validate_services' not in st.session_state:\n        st.session_state.force_validate_services = False\n    \n    # 模型选择状态\n    if 'selected_model' not in st.session_state:\n        st.session_state.selected_model = config.get_default_llm_id()\n    \n    # LLM 预设（精确/平衡/创意）\n    if 'llm_preset' not in st.session_state:\n        st.session_state.llm_preset = 'balanced'\n    \n    # RAG 检索策略\n    if 'retrieval_strategy' not in st.session_state:\n        st.session_state.retrieval_strategy = config.RETRIEVAL_STRATEGY\n    \n    # RAG 高级参数\n    if 'similarity_top_k' not in st.session_state:",

        "contents": "@dataclass\nclass AppConfig:\n@classmethod\ndef from_session_state(cls) -\u003e \"AppConfig\":\n\n        )\n    \n    def save_to_session_state(self) -\u003e None:\n        \"\"\"写入 session_state\"\"\"\n        st.session_state.selected_model = self.selected_model\n        st.session_state.llm_preset = self.llm_preset\n        st.session_state.retrieval_strategy = self.retrieval_strategy\n        st.session_state.use_agentic_rag = self.use_agentic_rag\n        st.session_state.similarity_top_k = self.similarity_top_k\n        st.session_state.similarity_threshold = self.similarity_threshold\n        st.session_state.enable_rerank = self.enable_rerank\n        st.session_state.show_reasoning = self.show_reasoning\n        st.session_state.debug_mode_enabled = self.debug_mode\n    \n    def get_llm_temperature(self) -\u003e Optional[float]:\n        \"\"\"获取当前预设的 temperature\n        \n        Returns:\n            temperature 值，推理模型返回 None\n        \"\"\"\n        # 检查是否为推理模型\n        model_config = config.get_llm_model_config(self.selected_model)\n        if model_config and model_config.supports_reasoning:\n            return None\n        \n        preset_params = get_preset_params(self.llm_preset)\n        return preset_params[\"temperature\"]\n    \n    def get_llm_max_tokens(self) -\u003e int:\n        \"\"\"获取当前预设的 max_tokens\"\"\"\n        preset_params = get_preset_params(self.llm_preset)\n        return preset_params[\"max_tokens\"]",

        "contents": "def render_sidebar(chat_manager) -\u003e None:\n    \"\"\"渲染侧边栏\n    \n    Args:\n        chat_manager: 对话管理器实例\n    \"\"\"\n    with st.sidebar:\n        # ========== 应用标题区域 ==========\n        st.title(\"📚 \" + config.APP_TITLE)\n        \n        # ========== 新对话（顶部） ==========\n        def _start_new_chat():\n            \"\"\"开启新对话的回调函数\"\"\"\n            if chat_manager:\n                chat_manager.start_session()\n            st.session_state.messages = []\n            # 清空引用来源映射\n            if 'current_sources_map' in st.session_state:\n                st.session_state.current_sources_map = {}\n            if 'current_reasoning_map' in st.session_state:\n                st.session_state.current_reasoning_map = {}\n            # 清空观察器日志\n            if 'llama_debug_logs' in st.session_state:\n                st.session_state.llama_debug_logs = []\n            if 'ragas_logs' in st.session_state:\n                st.session_state.ragas_logs = []\n        \n        st.button(\n            \"💬 开启新对话\", \n            type=\"primary\", \n            use_container_width=True, \n            key=\"new_chat_top\",\n            on_click=_start_new_chat\n        )\n        \n        st.divider()\n        \n        # ========== 历史会话列表 ==========\n        current_session_id = None\n        if chat_manager and chat_manager.current_session:\n            current_session_id = chat_manager.current_session.session_id\n        \n            display_session_history(current_session_id=current_session_id)\n        \n        st.divider()\n        \n        # ========== 底部固定工具栏 ==========\n        _render_sidebar_footer()\n        \n        # 检查是否需要显示设置弹窗\n        if st.session_state.get(\"show_settings_dialog\", False):\n            show_settings_dialog()\n            # 清除状态标志，避免下次 rerun 时再次显示弹窗\n            st.session_state.show_settings_dialog = False",

        "contents": "def rebuild_services() -\u003e bool:\n    \"\"\"重建 RAGService 和 ChatManager\n    \n    当配置变更时调用，根据当前 session_state 中的配置重建服务实例。\n    \n    Returns:\n        bool: 重建是否成功\n    \"\"\"\n    from backend.infrastructure.logger import get_logger\n    logger = get_logger('frontend.services')\n    \n    if 'init_result' not in st.session_state:\n        logger.warning(\"init_result 不存在，无法重建服务\")\n        return False\n    \n    init_result = st.session_state.init_result\n    index_manager = init_result.instances.get('index_manager')\n    \n    if index_manager is None:\n        # 标记需要重新初始化\n        logger.warning(\"index_manager 不存在，标记需要重新初始化\")\n        st.session_state.boot_ready = False\n        if 'init_result' in st.session_state:\n            del st.session_state.init_result\n        return False\n    \n    # 获取当前配置\n    from frontend.components.config_panel.models import AppConfig\n    app_config = AppConfig.from_session_state()\n    \n    # 获取 LLM 参数\n    temperature = app_config.get_llm_temperature()\n    max_tokens = app_config.get_llm_max_tokens()\n    \n    logger.info(\n        f\"重建服务: model={app_config.selected_model}, \"\n        f\"preset={app_config.llm_preset}, \"\n        f\"agentic={app_config.use_agentic_rag}, \"\n        f\"temperature={temperature}\"\n    )\n    \n    try:\n        # 延迟导入避免循环依赖\n        from backend.business.rag_api import RAGService",

        "contents": "\"\"\"\n对话显示组件\n\"\"\"\n\nimport streamlit as st\nfrom streamlit_chat import message\nfrom frontend.utils.helpers import get_chat_title\nfrom frontend.utils.sources import convert_sources_to_dict\nfrom frontend.utils.state import initialize_sources_map\nfrom frontend.utils.sources import format_answer_with_citation_links\nfrom frontend.components.sources_panel import display_sources_below_message\nfrom frontend.components.observability_summary import render_observability_summary\nfrom frontend.components.observer_renderers import render_llamadebug_full_info, render_ragas_full_info\nfrom backend.infrastructure.config import config\nfrom backend.infrastructure.logger import get_logger\n\nlogger = get_logger('app')\n\n\ndef render_chat_interface(rag_service, chat_manager) -\u003e None:\n    \"\"\"渲染对话界面\n    \n    优化：统一处理会话加载和rerun，减少重复渲染。\n    \n    Args:\n        rag_service: RAG服务实例\n        chat_manager: 对话管理器实例\n    \"\"\"\n    # 统一处理会话加载（优化：减少 rerun 次数）\n    if st.session_state.get('session_loading_pending') or st.session_state.get('load_session_id'):\n        from frontend.components.session_loader import load_history_session\n        if load_history_session(chat_manager):\n            st.rerun()\n    \n    # 注入全局JavaScript脚本（仅一次，必须在渲染任何消息前）\n    if not st.session_state.get('citation_script_injected', False):\n        from frontend.utils.sources import inject_citation_script\n        st.markdown(inject_citation_script(), unsafe_allow_html=True)\n        st.session_state.citation_script_injected = True\n    \n    # 显示标题\n    chat_title = get_chat_title(st.session_state.messages)\n    if chat_title:\n        st.subheader(chat_title)\n        st.markdown(\"---\")\n    \n    # 初始化来源映射\n    initialize_sources_map()\n    \n    # 无对话历史：显示快速开始",

        "contents": "def render_keyword_cloud() -\u003e None:\n    \"\"\"渲染探索知识库大框：词云区（气泡浮动）、已选词、生成问题、生成结果。\"\"\"\n    _ensure_state()\n    cloud = _load_keyword_cloud()\n    items = cloud[:MAX_CLOUD_ITEMS]\n    selected = st.session_state.keyword_cloud_selected\n    generated = st.session_state.keyword_cloud_generated\n    loading = st.session_state.keyword_cloud_loading\n\n    st.subheader(\"💡 探索知识库\")\n    st.caption(\"点击气泡选词（最多 5 个），再点击「生成问题」\")\n\n    if not items:\n        st.warning(\"未找到词云数据，请先运行 scripts/build_keyword_cloud.py 生成 data/keyword_cloud.json\")\n        return\n\n    # 词云区：streamlit-iframe-event + data URL，点击气泡 postMessage 回传选中词，组件返回值同步到 session_state\n    bubble_html = _build_bubble_cloud_html(items, selected)\n    try:\n        from streamlit_iframe_event import st_iframe_event\n\n        data_url = \"data:text/html;base64,\" + base64.b64encode(bubble_html.encode(\"utf-8\")).decode(\"ascii\")\n        event_value = st_iframe_event(data_url, key=\"keyword_cloud_iframe\", default_width=\"100%\")\n        if event_value is not None and isinstance(event_value, dict) and \"token\" in event_value:\n            try:\n                new_selected = json.loads(event_value[\"token\"])\n                if isinstance(new_selected, list):\n                    st.session_state.keyword_cloud_selected = new_selected\n                    selected = st.session_state.keyword_cloud_selected\n            except (TypeError, ValueError):\n                pass\n    except ImportError:\n        import streamlit.components.v1 as components\n\n        components.html(bubble_html, height=340, scrolling=False)\n        st.caption(\"气泡选词需安装 streamlit-iframe-event 才能与下方联动，请用下方多选选词。\")\n    st.markdown(\"---\")\n\n    # 已选词：从 URL 同步后与 session_state 一致，可在此勾选或依赖上方气泡\n    st.caption(\"已选词（最多 5 个，可点击上方气泡或在此勾选）\")\n    options = [item.get(\"word\", \"\") for item in items if item.get(\"word\")]\n    st.multiselect(\n        \"已选词\",\n        options=options,",
